answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 43947 Country: India Title: Income Question: A man who knows his income is unlawful or haram. He is offering five times of salah. He donated big amount madrasa. His relation with many Ulama my cause he is big donor. My question is that is his salah and donation to madrasa accepted to Allah (SWT)? Answer ID: 43947 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 356/262/D=1434) Is 100% income haram or some part of it? ان الله طيب لا يقبل الا طيباً Allah is pure and He accepts only that which is pure. Hence the person who gives money in madrasa should take it in mind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
